openIssues: FactView (FactView/MissingFactor/SkipCount/DoubleChain/FactFamily all use the ink NumberInput): not fully fixed. Measured: no overflow at container widths of 430 to 520px (the equation wraps above the input). Overflow starts below about 420px (at 360px the input is clipped on the left and the check button runs off the right). Cause: NumberInput's .pad has a 240px minimum width (--padW floor), and the tools and check add about 170px. This is ink-owned, so it needs a change in src/ink. Tablets (cards of at least 656px) are not affected.
